source_evidence: Player exact 'Present them all the evidence and the story' authorizes substantive disclosure and showing all Kestrel physical exhibits, papers and party testimony in this private audience, not surrendering originals or public dissemination. V recounts initial supervised visit, contradictions in discharge records, patient accounts of coerced treatment, injuries and immobilization, return to station, liberation of eleven people and evacuation to Sedgecross with care arrangements; no fabricated new patient outcomes. Present original directive naming Corven Nask with western Service Directorate regional bureau seal, two original EVERMARCH and CLEAR WILL order sets contemplating restraint/procedure despite objections, original transfer/requisition ledger, two false-discharge folios, signed local trial/injury packet, independent Mara Neri/witness notes, two binding inks/two refined crystalline components/two preservation salts sealed and silver-fitted instrument under Fenar custody. Cirren corroborates observed patient conditions and rescue; Mara corroborates observations and interview notes within her knowledge; Fenar corroborates recovery and evacuation. No claimed higher leadership orders or whole-state conspiracy beyond evidence. Councillor independently takes seriously the combination of original documents and multiple witnesses; asks to authenticate seals, signatures, records and testimonies, offers supervised certified copies and confidential survivor-contact inquiry subject to consent. No opposed social check warranted for receiving and evaluating material and making nonbinding professional offer; no final official finding, public release, declaration, order, political title or guaranteed action. No actual transfer, copies or samples opened. Approximately45 minutes elapsed, secretary records audience minutes (not certified document copies). D315~11:15 Caereth palace private council chamber, V/Elara/Mara/Cirren/Fenar present with security councillor and royal secretary. At V's express direction all currently held Kestrel evidence and party's firsthand account presented for supervised examination: western Service Directorate regional bureau original directive naming Corven Nask, original EVERMARCH and CLEAR WILL experiment orders, transfer/requisition ledger, contradictory false-discharge folios, signed clinical trial/injury packet, Mara witness notes, Fenar six sealed labelled reagent vials and silver-fitted measuring instrument. Testimony distinguishes personally witnessed abuse, rescue of eleven and last known care arrangements from unknown current whereabouts or higher command knowledge; no claims of proven head-of-state order or divine murders. Councillor takes report seriously, acknowledges prima facie regional institutional involvement requiring authentication and corroboration, offers to arrange confidential Crown review, certified copies under V's supervision, and an appropriate secure channel to obtain voluntary survivor statements; no order for war, public accusation, guaranteed sanctuary, official findings or royal audience with monarch, no copies made or originals surrendered yet. He asks permission to make copies of the records and whether V seeks a confidential diplomatic/investigative response or a public statement after verification. V decides. No further time or costs beyond audience discussion. All evidence remains in original custody; pending conditional240gp sale not received, other early silver pieces unverified. Purse203gp4sp6cp food21/feed28 rest5/6 all HP/resources full V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 cloak+Luckstone, Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive, Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 full slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots equipped, Mara/Elara/horses healthy. Defense quest meeting late afternoon D315, no new milestone earned; alliance reply pending. Dice delegated until stop.
